verdict.rationale: gstack is a skill pack driven by agents through slash-command skills, including a router skill that dispatches requests ([gstack-docs-18]), and a documented compiled browser CLI ($B) backed by a headless Chromium daemon ([gstack-docs-14], [gstack-docs-25]). Hosts are defined as typed TypeScript config objects ([gstack-docs-13]). Together these give agents a scriptable, documented surface, but none of it is a public API in the usual sense. Missing for 10: a documented public API (HTTP/SDK or a stable programmatic interface with reference docs), a command reference for the $B CLI, and independent corroboration of programmatic control.
